tasks.title: Cover markdown export with focused tests
acceptance: Tests verify markdown output contains all expected mapping fields.
Tests verify multiple selected maps produce multiple files or file-write requests.

tasks.title: Add deterministic CE record correlation
tasks.notes: Added a narrow result-surface regression test so completed Testify runs cannot report success when deterministic CE correlation failed. The core CE correlation implementation and integration coverage were already present in durable state.
tasks.blocker: Manual override: implementation and focused regression coverage are present; full validation remains blocked by shared-workspace testhost file locking.
acceptance: Testify queries CE by a deterministic correlation key for each exercised map leg
Create verification fails if the correlated CE row is missing, duplicated, or unrelated to the FO test record
Update verification reuses the same correlated CE row instead of accepting any CE count delta
constraints: Do not redesign overall Testify planning flow
Limit scope to correlation, duplicate detection, and row identity checks on the CE side

tasks.title: Implement CE field reconciliation assertions
tasks.notes: Read back the correlated CE row and compare mapped values against FO source values and transform output, including enums, lookups, null semantics, dates, numerics, and booleans where supported by the map.
acceptance: Testify reads CE column values for the correlated row after create and patch operations
Result rows show pass or fail per verified mapped field instead of count-only success
Enum or option-set outcomes are validated against expected CE target values
Date, numeric, boolean, and null handling are asserted when those mapped fields are in scope
constraints: Only verify fields discoverable from the selected map metadata
Do not add reverse-direction sync coverage in this task

tasks.title: Add FO persisted-value readback checks
tasks.notes: After FO create and FO patch, GET the FO record and verify persisted values rather than accepting HTTP success alone.
acceptance: FO create path performs a readback of the created record
FO patch path performs a readback confirming the intended field transition persisted
Failures distinguish transport success from persistence mismatch
constraints: Keep verification focused on fields Testify explicitly wrote or depends on for mapping
Do not expand into bulk or resilience scenarios

tasks.title: Validate CE cleanup outcomes
tasks.notes: Track CE artifacts created during Testify and verify cleanup behavior such as delete, deactivate, unlink, or expected retained state per map behavior.
acceptance: Testify records the correlated CE row identifiers it created or touched
Cleanup validates the expected post-cleanup CE state for each tracked artifact
Result output reports CE cleanup success or residual artifacts explicitly
constraints: Do not attempt generic environment-wide CE cleanup
Only validate artifacts created or correlated during the current Testify run

tasks.title: Add dual-write readiness preflight checks
tasks.notes: Extend preflight to validate dual-write operational readiness, target schema usability, and unsupported map shape classification before running Testify.
acceptance: Preflight reports dual-write health indicators required for deterministic test execution
CE schema validation confirms target entity and required columns are queryable before verification runs
Unsupported map shapes are classified with explicit reasons instead of falling through to weak execution
constraints: Keep checks read-only
Do not implement outage simulation, backlog draining, or resilience testing in this task

tasks.title: Persist machine-readable Testify reports
tasks.notes: Export preflight findings, verification outcomes, mismatches, CE correlation details, and latency measurements to a durable report artifact.

constraints: Do not build a new reporting service
